scope: Isolated Guaíra experimental map; no campaign or save-schema changes
origin: Original deterministic Blender scene; third craft pass plus one bounded dry Bairro public standpipe and stone receiver
renderer: Blender 4.3.2 / Cycles CPU / 48 samples / AgX medium-high contrast / no denoising
metadataChanges: No metadata changes; exact camera, node projections, route projections, worldRoutes, routeWidth and all 16 walk meshes/transforms preserved
visualChanges: Three village houses with curved overlapping clay tile shells, individual limewash, recessed chestnut doors and teal louvered shutters, grouped masonry wear and stone footings
Single attached sage repair bay with workbench and spare hydraulic parts; sheltered dry-bank vegetation; restrained mature rice heads and a compact bank-side keeper/harvest group
Seated reservoir shutter, fitted sandstone outlet throat and return joints, service foothold and bronze pipe supports; original water surfaces retained
One grounded dry carved-sandstone receiver and buried bronze standpipe beside the repair bay; chapter-local vector water is separately derived from actual visible source geometry

staticAudit.method: Evaluated Blender geometry with Blender loop triangulation; both-facing native opaque-pixel union, 5 subpixel rays per pixel; full-body and face included
staticAudit.inheritedContactExplanation: All intersections match baseline object and hit location within 0.0001 world unit. They are in the last three native sprite rows against existing walk clearings/planks or bridge inlet water; two lateral support probes meet the existing gap between bridge planks. The production map painter draws Feka over the base. No head, face, body scenery or newly introduced contact.

excludedFromProduction: Scratch component scripts, proofs, screenshots, and intermediate renders
limitations: Static evaluated-geometry differential audit and offline production painter review; integration browser navigation/focus verification remains separate. Existing foot/floor contacts and bridge-gap support probes are explicitly reported, not hidden as a clean zero.

waterDecoration.origin: Occluded emission mask of authored Blender water surfaces, with one source-pixel inset

productionPainterAudit.scope: Actual production painter and new image/mask in native offline canvas; not browser/GPU FPS measurement

buildCost.note: Historical third-craft integration build measurement; remeasure complete build after integrating chapter payoff code. New authored base-image delta alone is +278 bytes.

lossyRGBOutsideEnvelope.explanation: VP8 lossy re-encoding propagates RGB quantization changes beyond a local master edit. It is codec drift, not source scenery changes. Alpha is exact.

bairroPublicWater.scope: Art geometry and packaging only; accepted-receipt behavior belongs to chapter runtime tests
